chapter_mission: From the apartment, Ben and Talon watch news coverage frame Korda as the rogue center of the scandal. Aelia is pressured toward stepping down to preserve the Foundation. The public version of events is already calcifying — and it is incompatible with anything Ben could prove in the time remaining.
chapter_turn: Ben, Talon, and Luke (by holo) see the public story is too neat. The cover is moving faster than the truth.
